training_target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

input_priority.policy: Side: q0 primary; flexion/extension: q1/q2/q3 primary. Soft preference, not a guaranteed derivative ratio.

side_motor_mapping: q0-only anchor plus bending correction; negative correction smoothly bounded, positive payout preserved
training_scope: Formal full (thumb) or xy (other fingers), including movement timeouts; ring point_id<2214
fit_limitation: Validation is raw recorded motor feedback, NOT rebased motor-zero control accuracy or hardware tracking. Reference can lie outside sampled poses; neutral subtraction does not calibrate physical zero. No robot test or closed-loop q control performed. Ring uses four same-session targets from ring_data, whereas the current polynomial uses older extensor/flexor data.

training.side_head_architecture: q0:4→W→W→1 mixed_softplus; bending:4→W→W→1 tanh; disjoint input masks
training.note: Per-side training is in side_training; M11/M13 retain earlier training fields.

control_policy_validation_note: Side held-out metrics evaluate raw measured feedback predictions, before neutral alignment and the side winding cap, not hardware accuracy. M11/M13 metrics are inherited.

extensor_structure.q0_constraint: unconstrained; secondary input gain 0.25 and weak-path penalty
extensor_structure.guarantee: At fixed q0, raw/neutral-aligned extensor output is nondecreasing in q1/q2/q3. No positive lower slope or correct out-of-domain amplitude is guaranteed.

source_training.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
source_training.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees
source_training.note: M11 retains extensor_training/extensor_validation; side branch retains original training.

extensor_training.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on all original rows
extensor_training.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

flexor_structure.output_activation: identity then fixed sign -1, before output de-standardization
flexor_structure.guarantee: At fixed other inputs, increasing q1/q2/q3 never increases M13 motor position (never reduces winding). No minimum winding slope or OOD accuracy guarantee.

flexor_training.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
flexor_training.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

side_structure.guarantee: M18 is nonincreasing and M20 nondecreasing in q0, including after the side policy. Bending correction is independent of q0. No amplitude or hardware tracking guarantee.

18.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
18.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

20.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees
